claims.evidence: Photos show the melodica and case but no close-up wear assessment; the witness report does not describe condition.
No view of the instrument interior or repair seals; exterior photos cannot prove repair history.
The witness report lists key/button function and air tightness as not shown.
Receipt and warranty are not in any photo; their existence cannot be confirmed remotely without document images.

risks.risk: Keys or chord buttons may not sound or may be sticky.
risks.proof: Video of the melodica being played with every key and chord button pressed while air is blown through the tube.

risks.risk: Internal reeds may be damaged or air may leak, reducing sound quality and playability.
risks.proof: Close-up video of sustained notes and an air-leak check, or photos of the reed block interior.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing reed repair or unplayable

risks.risk: Blow tube or mouthpiece may be missing, damaged, or unsanitary.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the tube and mouthpiece, plus confirmation it is included.
risks.if_unproven: priced without a tube or mouthpiece

risks.risk: Age and usage history are unknown; heavy wear may not be visible in the photos.
risks.proof: Detailed photos of exterior wear, serial number, and any signs of use.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used with unknown age

risks.risk: Original receipt and warranty may not exist or may not be transferable.
risks.proof: Photo of the original receipt and warranty document.

proof_requests: Video demonstrating every key and chord button sounds while blowing into the tube.
Close-up photos of the blow tube, mouthpiece, and case interior.
Photo of the original receipt and warranty document.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Yamaha melodica, so a worst-case price is possible even though function, age, and documents are unproven.
